nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Public address state variable holding the pending new owner, written by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership.
Public string token symbol, set to CHT in the CharityToken constructor.
Public string token name, set to Charity Token in the CharityToken constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 4 in the CharityToken constructor.
Public uint holding the total token supply, assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances used by balanceOf, transfer and transferFrom.
Mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances used by approve, transferFrom, approveAndCall and allowance.
Pure addition helper that computes c = a + b and reverts if c < a (overflow guard).
Pure subtraction helper that requires b <= a before computing c = a - b (underflow guard).
Pure multiplication helper computing c = a * b with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Pure division helper requiring b > 0 before computing c = a / b.
Constructor of Owned that assigns the deployer msg.sender as owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner; performs no zero-address validation before writing.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, promotes newOwner to owner and zeroes newOwner.
Token constructor that sets symbol/name/decimals, mints the entire supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to `to` using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from `from` to `to` while decrementing the caller allowance via safeSub; allowance is not checked against balances.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance and then performs an external call to spender's receiveApproval, creating a re-entrancy surface.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting raw ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary tokenAddress contract, sending tokens to owner; vulnerable to malicious token contracts.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances, allowances and external call parameters.
External call into an attacker-supplied spender contract from approveAndCall (reentrancy surface).
External call to an arbitrary tokenAddress contract inside transferAnyERC20Token (reentrancy / malicious token surface).
Arithmetic operation _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed without SafeMath underflow protection.
Access-control weakness: newOwner may be written as address(0), permanently locking ownership.
First uint operand of safeAdd.

Return/local variable c of safeSub holding the difference.

Second uint operand of safeMul.
Return/local variable c of safeMul holding the product.

Denominator uint parameter of safeDiv.
Return/local variable c of safeDiv holding the quotient.
Address parameter staged as the pending new owner.
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Recipient address of the transfer call.
Amount of tokens to transfer.
Address granted the allowance.
Allowance amount granted.
Address whose balance is debited in transferFrom.
Recipient address in transferFrom.
Amount moved in transferFrom.
Owner address queried in allowance.
Spender address queried in allowance.
Address granted the allowance and targeted by the external receiveApproval call.
Allowance amount and tokens argument forwarded to receiveApproval.
Calldata bytes forwarded to spender.receiveApproval.
Arbitrary contract address that is externally called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Token amount forwarded to the external transfer call.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner state variable.
Owned constructor body consumes the caller address msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership with require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner guard of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner value into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
newOwner is the storage slot mutated by transferOwnership.
CharityToken constructor initialises the symbol state variable.
CharityToken constructor initialises the name state variable.
CharityToken constructor initialises the decimals state variable.
CharityToken constructor assigns the total supply.
CharityToken constructor mints the entire supply into balances for the fixed address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] and subtracts it without SafeMath.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed before the external call.
transfer invokes safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balances[from] and the allowance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd on balances[to].
approveAndCall dispatches the external receiveApproval call to the spender contract.
The untrusted spender contract can re-enter approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall during receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external transfer call on an arbitrary token contract.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token or other owner functions.
owner is read by the onlyOwner guard and is the recipient of the external transfer.
transferOwnership writes newOwner without validating against address(0).
The missing zero-address check allows newOwner to be set to address(0), locking ownership.

The _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable without validation.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.

to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
tokens parameter scales both balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
spender parameter supplies the target contract address for the external call.
tokenAddress parameter supplies the arbitrary contract target of the external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
